scenes.title: Cosmic Trap
scenes.text: A black hole is not empty. It is gravity so strong that not even light can escape its pull.

scenes.title: Predicted
scenes.text: Einstein predicted them with math a century ago. Nobody believed such things could really exist.

scenes.title: First Photo
scenes.text: In twenty nineteen, the first image showed a glowing ring around a shadow, proving the math right.

scenes.title: Our Galaxy
scenes.text: A supermassive black hole sits at the center of our galaxy, quietly holding billions of stars.

scenes.title: Time Bends
scenes.text: Near a black hole, time slows down. An hour there could be years for everyone back on Earth.

scenes.title: Spaghettify
scenes.text: Fall in feet first and gravity stretches you into a long thin strand before you reach the center.

scenes.title: Information
scenes.text: Physics still argues about what happens to information swallowed by a black hole. The debate is alive.

scenes.title: Your Question
scenes.text: The universe keeps its strangest secrets in the dark. What would you ask a black hole?
